newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea bond yields end down as liquidity improves.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea bond yields end down as liquidity improves.

text.p: Key bond yields closed lower on Wednesday on the back of an improving liquidity situation, dealers said.
They said buying sentiment was also boosted by speculation that interest rates would fall in line with the government's financial industry restructuring plan.

Call rates also fell on improving liquidity. * 3-yr corporates close at 12.40 pct vs Tuesday's 12.45 * 3-mth CDs end at 12.80 pct vs Tuesday's 12.85 * Average overnight call rate at 11.3 pct vs Tuesday's 11.8 -------------------------------------------------------------
Cash liquidity improved as commercial banks cashed in 300 billion won worth of repurchase agreements on maturity, dealers said.
They expected the benchmark three-year yields to fall to around the 12.35 percent level on Thursday, and further to the 12.30 percent level by the weekend.
